correctness.rationale: For |R|<=r=sum_{j>1}|a_j|, conditioning on R gives P(|a1*U1+R|>t)=1-t/a1 whenever 0<t<a1-r: exactly flat uniform density on all shifted central intervals. The coupling sup difference from U1 is <=|1-a1|+r and compact support plus positive Q(t) localize ALL global maximizing cutoffs near the source’s unique t0 as r→0. Within that plateau, F=(a1-t)/(a1*Q(t)) and the sign of derivative is a1-t-h(t), with (t+h(t))’=3t*h(t)>0; hence unique optimizer. With a1=sqrt(1-s), implicit derivative gives dt/ds=-1/[6t0(1-t0)]; envelope gives dK/ds=-t0/[2Q(t0)]. Independent numeric root gave t0=0.64290833503198, C*=1.34511821204919, kappa=1.21087635888558. Finite numeric checks are not proof of dimension-free eta.

value.rationale: Sharp global inequalities naturally invite near-extremizer stability. This yields a dimension-free local structural theorem, an exact dependence of optimized tail ratio on dominant weight, and a computable tangent-space quadratic deficit for all finite dimensions.
